title: Choosing a preferred supplier
grammar: would rather / prefer … to / rather than (preferências de fornecedor)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a expressar preferências de fornecedor com would rather, prefer … to e rather than. Em Compras, isso é essencial para comparar propostas e explicar por que você escolhe um fornecedor em vez de outro na Delta Ducon.
intro: In Procurement you often compare options: one supplier offers a lower price, another a shorter lead time. You have to say which one you prefer and why.
Today we learn would rather, prefer … to, and rather than. With these forms you can explain your choice of supplier clearly and sound professional at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Bruno from Procurement. I would rather work with a reliable supplier than save a little money. I prefer a short lead time to a low price. When two bids are close, I prefer to negotiate rather than accept the first offer. Let us practise talking about preferences together.
vocab: We would rather work with a reliable supplier.
The local bid was lower than the others.
I prefer a supplier with a short lead time.
We would rather pay more for a longer warranty.
They prefer to include freight in the price.
We would rather accept these payment terms.
practice: We would rather work with a reliable ______.
The local ______ was lower than the others.
I prefer a supplier with a short ______.
We would rather pay more for a longer ______.
They prefer to include ______ in the price.
We would rather accept these payment ______.
This ______ has better delivery than the others.
A two-year ______ gives us more security.

audio.title: Comparing two suppliers
audio.text: When I compare suppliers, I would rather choose quality than the lowest bid. I prefer a supplier with a short lead time to one that is often late. For big orders, we would rather pay a little more than risk a delay. I prefer to negotiate the freight rather than accept the first offer. The client would rather have a longer warranty than a small discount. In the end, we always prefer a partner we can trust.

readAloud: I would rather work with a local supplier.
We prefer a short lead time to a low price.
They would rather pay more than accept a delay.
I prefer to negotiate the freight rather than pay it.
We would rather choose quality than save money.
fill: We would rather ___ steel from a local supplier. (order)
The client would rather ___ for quality parts. (pay)
I prefer ___ two quotations before deciding. (compare)
They prefer to lease the equipment rather than ___ it. (buy)
We would rather not ___ the deadline. (miss)
She prefers ___ by email rather than by phone. (negotiate)
We would rather ___ delivery than accept damaged goods. (delay)
I would rather the supplier ___ the parts today. (ship)
qa: Which supplier do you prefer?
I would rather work with the local supplier.
Do you prefer a low price or a short lead time?
I prefer a short lead time to a low price.
Would you accept a delay to save money?
No, I would rather pay more than accept a delay.
How do you prefer to handle the freight?
I prefer to negotiate the freight rather than accept it.
What does the client prefer?
The client would rather have a longer warranty than a discount.
sentences: I would rather work with a reliable supplier than a cheap one.
We prefer a short lead time to a low price.
They would rather pay more than risk a delay.
I prefer to negotiate the freight rather than accept the first offer.
The client would rather have a longer warranty than a discount.
We prefer local suppliers to distant ones.
I would rather not order from that supplier again.
She prefers to compare three bids rather than accept one.
grammarPoint: Para dizer preferências use: would rather + verbo no infinitivo sem 'to' (I would rather order today. — Eu preferiria pedir hoje.); prefer + substantivo ou to-infinitive, e prefer X to Y (I prefer this supplier to that one. — Prefiro este fornecedor àquele.); rather than + verbo base (We buy locally rather than import. — Compramos localmente em vez de importar.).
deepDive: Cuidado: depois de would rather NÃO se usa 'to' — é would rather order, nunca 'would rather to order'. Para preferências sobre outra pessoa, use would rather + sujeito + passado: I would rather the supplier shipped today (Eu preferiria que o fornecedor enviasse hoje). Com prefer há dois padrões: prefer to do … rather than do (prefer to lease rather than buy) e prefer X to Y (prefer steel to aluminium). O 'to' de prefer X to Y é preposição, não infinitivo.
examples: I would rather order today than wait.
Eu preferiria pedir hoje a esperar.
We prefer a short lead time to a low price.
Preferimos um prazo curto a um preço baixo.
They would rather pay more than risk a delay.
Eles preferem pagar mais a arriscar um atraso.
I prefer to lease the equipment rather than buy it.
Prefiro alugar o equipamento em vez de comprá-lo.
She would rather not sign the contract today.
Ela preferiria não assinar o contrato hoje.
We prefer local suppliers to distant ones.
Preferimos fornecedores locais aos distantes.
I would rather the supplier called us first.
Eu preferiria que o fornecedor nos ligasse primeiro.
He prefers negotiating by email to calling.
Ele prefere negociar por e-mail a ligar.
mistakes: I would rather to order today.
I would rather order today.
Depois de would rather não se usa 'to'; use o verbo base.
We prefer steel than aluminium.
We prefer steel to aluminium.
Com prefer X … Y use 'to', não 'than'.
They would rather paying more.
They would rather pay more.
Would rather pede o verbo base, não o gerúndio.
I prefer to buy locally than import.
I prefer to buy locally rather than import.
Com prefer to do use 'rather than', não só 'than'.
I would rather the supplier ships today.
I would rather the supplier shipped today.
Para preferência sobre outra pessoa, use would rather + passado (shipped).
quick: They would rather ___ more than wait. (pay)
We prefer to lease rather than ___. (own)
I would rather the supplier ___ today. (ship)

celebrate.en: Well done. Expressing your preferences clearly helps you choose the right supplier and defend your decisions in English.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Expressar suas preferências com clareza ajuda a escolher o fornecedor certo e a defender suas decisões em inglês.

title: Setting conditions in contracts
grammar: unless / as long as / provided (that) — condições em contratos
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a definir condições com unless, as long as e provided (that). Em Compras, essas conjunções deixam claros os termos de um contrato: quando você paga, quando há multa e quando o preço se mantém na Delta Ducon.
intro: Contracts are full of conditions: we pay on time provided the parts arrive, and the supplier keeps the price as long as we order in bulk.
Today we learn unless, as long as, and provided (that). These words let you set clear conditions with suppliers at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Carla from Procurement. We will sign the contract provided that the supplier confirms the lead time. As long as they deliver on time, we keep the order. Unless the price changes in writing, the deal stands. Let us practise setting conditions.
vocab: This clause sets the delivery conditions.
There is a penalty unless the parts arrive on time.
We pay a deposit provided the order is confirmed.
We will not miss the deadline unless there is a delay.
We accept the agreement as long as the price stays the same.
They give a discount if we order a full batch.
practice: We accept the ______ as long as the price stays the same.
There is a ______ unless the parts arrive on time.
We pay a ______ provided the order is confirmed.
The supplier gives a discount as long as we order a full ______.
We will not miss the ______ unless there is a delay.
The contract is valid provided both sides sign the ______.
Read the penalty ______ before you sign.

audio.title: Reading the supplier contract
audio.text: We will sign the agreement provided that the supplier confirms the lead time. As long as they deliver on time, there is no penalty. Unless the price changes in writing, we keep the same terms. We pay the deposit provided the order is confirmed by email. The supplier gives a discount as long as we order a full batch each month. Everyone is happy unless someone misses a deadline.

readAloud: We will sign the contract provided that the price stays the same.
As long as the supplier delivers on time, there is no penalty.
Unless the parts arrive today, we will be late.
We pay the deposit provided the order is confirmed.
The discount holds as long as we order in bulk.
fill: We will sign provided the supplier ___ the lead time. (confirm)
Unless the parts ___ on time, we pay a penalty. (arrive)
As long as they ___ the price, we keep the order. (hold)
We pay the deposit provided the order ___ confirmed. (be)
Unless the supplier ___ us, we will not know the date. (call)
The discount holds as long as we ___ in bulk. (order)
Provided that the invoice ___ correct, we pay on time. (be)
Unless the price ___, the deal stands. (change)
qa: When will you sign the contract?
We will sign it provided that the supplier confirms the lead time.
What happens if the parts are late?
There is a penalty unless the parts arrive on time.
Will you keep the same price?
Yes, as long as we order in bulk.
When do you pay the deposit?
We pay the deposit provided the order is confirmed.
Is the deal still valid?
Yes, unless the price changes, the deal stands.
sentences: We will sign the contract provided that the price stays the same.
Unless the parts arrive on time, we pay a penalty.
As long as the supplier delivers on schedule, we keep the order.
We pay the deposit provided the order is confirmed in writing.
Unless the supplier calls us, we will not know the delivery date.
The discount holds as long as we order a full batch.
Provided that the invoice is correct, we pay within thirty days.
We will not renew the agreement unless the terms improve.
grammarPoint: Estas conjunções introduzem condições. Unless = 'a menos que / se não': Unless the parts arrive, we pay a penalty. — A menos que as peças cheguem, pagamos multa. As long as e provided (that) = 'desde que': We keep the price as long as you order in bulk. — Mantemos o preço desde que você compre em grande quantidade. Depois delas, use o presente para falar do futuro.
deepDive: Unless já é negativo (= if not), então não use 'not' junto: diga Unless the supplier confirms, não 'Unless the supplier doesn't confirm'. Depois de unless, as long as e provided that, use o presente mesmo falando do futuro: As long as they deliver (não 'will deliver'). Provided that e providing that são iguais, e o 'that' é opcional. As long as também pode indicar tempo, mas aqui usamos como condição ('desde que').
examples: Unless the parts arrive today, we will be late.
A menos que as peças cheguem hoje, vamos atrasar.
We keep the price as long as you order in bulk.
Mantemos o preço desde que você compre em grande quantidade.
We will sign provided that the terms are clear.
Assinaremos desde que os termos estejam claros.
There is no penalty as long as delivery is on time.
Não há multa desde que a entrega seja no prazo.
Unless the price changes, the deal stands.
A menos que o preço mude, o acordo se mantém.
We pay the deposit provided the order is confirmed.
Pagamos o sinal desde que o pedido seja confirmado.
You get a discount as long as you pay early.
Você ganha desconto desde que pague adiantado.
We will not renew unless the service improves.
Não renovaremos a menos que o serviço melhore.
mistakes: Unless the supplier doesn't confirm, we wait.
Unless the supplier confirms, we wait.
Unless já significa 'se não'; não use 'not' junto.
As long as they will deliver, we keep the order.
As long as they deliver, we keep the order.
Depois de as long as use o presente, não 'will'.
Provided the price will stay, we sign.
Provided the price stays, we sign.
Provided pede presente, não futuro.
We pay unless the order is confirmed.
We pay provided the order is confirmed.
Aqui a condição é positiva ('desde que'), use provided, não unless.
Unless of a delay, there is no penalty.
Unless there is a delay, there is no penalty.
Unless introduz uma oração com sujeito e verbo, não um substantivo.
quick: Unless the parts ___ today, we pay a penalty. (arrive)
As long as they ___ on time, we keep the order. (deliver)
We sign provided the price ___ the same. (stay)
We pay the deposit provided the order ___ confirmed. (be)
Unless the supplier ___ us, we will not know. (call)

celebrate.en: Great work. Setting clear conditions is how good contracts are made, and now you can do it in English.
celebrate.pt: Ótimo trabalho. Definir condições claras é como se fazem bons contratos, e agora você sabe fazer isso em inglês.

title: Chasing a late order
grammar: had better / it's (high) time + past (cobrar ação em pedidos atrasados)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a cobrar ação com had better e it's (high) time + passado. Em Compras, essas formas ajudam você a pressionar fornecedores com firmeza quando um pedido está atrasado na Delta Ducon.
intro: When an order is late, you have to push: the supplier had better ship today, and it is high time we received an update.
Today we learn had better and it is (high) time + past. These forms help you chase late orders firmly but politely at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Diego from Procurement. The supplier had better send the parts this week. It is high time we received the filter bags. We had better call them now before the deadline. Let us learn to push for action in English.
vocab: The supplier has a big backlog this month.
It is high time we had an update on the order.
The dispatch is two days late.
I sent a reminder about the late order.
The delivery is three days overdue.
The delay needs an escalation to the manager.
practice: The supplier has a large ______ this month.
It is high time we had an ______ on the order.
The ______ of the filter bags is two days late.
I sent a ______ about the late delivery.
The shipment is now three days ______.
This delay needs an ______ to the manager.
We had better send another ______ today.
The payment is ______, so we must chase it.

audio.title: The order is overdue
audio.text: The steel order is three days overdue, so we had better act now. It is high time the supplier sent an update. I have sent two reminders, but the dispatch is still stuck in their backlog. We had better escalate this before the deadline. It is high time we spoke to the manager directly. The client is waiting, so they had better ship the parts today.

readAloud: The supplier had better ship the parts today.
It is high time we received an update.
We had better send another reminder now.
It is time the dispatch left the warehouse.
You had better not miss this deadline.
fill: The supplier had better ___ the parts today. (send)
It is high time we ___ an update. (get)
We had better ___ the manager now. (call)
It is time the supplier ___ our emails. (answer)
You had better not ___ the deadline. (miss)
It is high time they ___ the parts. (ship)
We had better ___ this to the director. (escalate)
It is time we ___ a new supplier. (find)
qa: The order is late. What should the supplier do?
They had better ship the parts today.
Have you heard from the supplier?
No, and it is high time we received an update.
What should we do about the delay?
We had better escalate it to the manager.
Is it too early to change suppliers?
No, it is high time we found a new one.
What is your advice about the deadline?
You had better not miss it.
sentences: The supplier had better ship the parts today.
It is high time we received an update on the order.
We had better send another reminder before noon.
It is time the dispatch left the warehouse.
You had better not miss this deadline.
It is high time the supplier answered our emails.
We had better escalate this delay to the manager.
It is time we found a more reliable supplier.
grammarPoint: Had better + verbo base dá um conselho forte ou aviso, quase uma ameaça educada: You had better ship today. — É melhor você enviar hoje. It is (high) time + passado diz que algo já devia ter acontecido: It is high time we ordered more bags. — Já está mais do que na hora de pedirmos mais mangas.
deepDive: Had better costuma aparecer contraído: You'd better call now. A negativa é had better not (You had better not be late), nunca 'had not better'. Nunca use 'to' depois: had better send, não 'had better to send'. Em it is time + sujeito + verbo, o verbo vai para o passado mesmo falando do presente ou futuro (é um passado 'irreal'): It is time we changed suppliers. Você também pode dizer it is time to + infinitivo quando não há sujeito específico. High time e about time deixam a cobrança mais forte.
examples: The supplier had better deliver on time.
É melhor o fornecedor entregar no prazo.
You had better not forget the deadline.
É melhor você não esquecer o prazo.
It is high time we received the parts.
Já está mais do que na hora de recebermos as peças.
We had better call the supplier now.
É melhor ligarmos para o fornecedor agora.
It is time the dispatch left the warehouse.
Já está na hora de a expedição sair do almoxarifado.
They had better answer our reminder.
É melhor eles responderem à nossa cobrança.
It is about time they updated the schedule.
Já era hora de eles atualizarem o cronograma.
We had better escalate this to the manager.
É melhor escalarmos isso para o gerente.
mistakes: The supplier had better to ship today.
The supplier had better ship today.
Depois de had better não se usa 'to'.
You had not better miss the deadline.
You had better not miss the deadline.
A negativa é had better not, nesta ordem.
It is high time we receive the parts.
It is high time we received the parts.
Depois de it is time + sujeito, o verbo vai para o passado.
We had better calling the supplier.
We had better call the supplier.
Had better pede o verbo base, não o gerúndio.
It is time we order more bags.
It is time we ordered more bags.
Use o passado (ordered) depois de it is time we.
quick: It is high time we ___ an update. (get)
You had better not ___ the deadline. (miss)
It is time they ___ our emails. (answer)
We had better ___ the manager now. (call)

celebrate.en: Excellent. Pushing firmly for action is part of Procurement, and now you can chase a late order in clear English.
celebrate.pt: Excelente. Cobrar ação com firmeza faz parte de Compras, e agora você consegue perseguir um pedido atrasado em inglês claro.

title: The sooner we order, the better
grammar: the + comparativo, the + comparativo (the sooner …, the lower …)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a estrutura the + comparativo, the + comparativo para ligar duas variáveis ('quanto mais…, mais…'). Em Compras, isso ajuda a explicar trade-offs e argumentar em negociações na Delta Ducon.
intro: In Procurement two things often move together: the sooner you order, the lower the price; the bigger the batch, the better the discount.
Today we learn the … the … comparative. It helps you explain trade-offs and negotiate with suppliers at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Elisa from Procurement. The sooner we place the order, the lower the freight cost. The larger the batch, the bigger the discount. The clearer the contract, the fewer the problems. Let us practise linking two ideas in English.
vocab: The bigger the order, the bigger the discount.
The sooner we ship, the lower the freight.
The higher the volume, the better the price.
The longer the delay, the higher the cost.
The lower the price, the smaller the margin.
The better the negotiation, the lower the price.
practice: The bigger the order, the bigger the ______.
The sooner we ship, the lower the ______.
The higher the ______, the better the price.
The longer the delay, the higher the ______.
The lower the price, the smaller the ______.
The better the ______, the lower the final price.
A larger ______ usually means a lower unit price.
A bulk order earns a bigger ______.

audio.title: Two things that move together
audio.text: In Procurement, two things often move together. The sooner we place an order, the lower the freight cost. The larger the volume, the bigger the discount from the supplier. The longer we wait, the higher the price becomes. The clearer the contract, the fewer the problems later. And the better we negotiate, the more money we save. So we always order early and buy in bulk.

readAloud: The sooner we order, the lower the price.
The larger the batch, the bigger the discount.
The longer the delay, the higher the cost.
The clearer the contract, the fewer the problems.
The better we negotiate, the more we save.
fill: The sooner we order, the ___ the price. (low)
The larger the batch, the ___ the discount. (big)
The longer the delay, the ___ the cost. (high)
The clearer the contract, the ___ problems. (few)
The better we negotiate, the ___ we save. (much)
The higher the volume, the ___ the unit price. (cheap)
The earlier we pay, the ___ the discount. (good)
The bigger the order, the ___ the margin for them. (small)
qa: Why should we order early?
Because the sooner we order, the lower the price.
Does a bigger batch help?
Yes, the larger the batch, the bigger the discount.
What happens if we delay?
The longer the delay, the higher the cost.
How does a clear contract help?
The clearer the contract, the fewer the problems.
Does negotiation matter?
Yes, the better we negotiate, the more we save.

b.label: the more ..., the more ...
b.placeholder: The more we order, the more ...

sentences: The sooner we order, the lower the price.
The larger the batch, the bigger the discount.
The longer the delay, the higher the cost.
The clearer the contract, the fewer the problems.
The better we negotiate, the more we save.
The higher the volume, the cheaper the unit price.
The earlier we pay, the better the terms.
The more suppliers we compare, the smarter our choice.
grammarPoint: A estrutura the + comparativo, the + comparativo liga duas coisas que variam juntas: 'quanto mais…, mais…'. The sooner we order, the lower the price. — Quanto mais cedo pedimos, mais baixo o preço. Cada parte começa com the e traz um comparativo (sooner, lower, bigger, more, fewer).
deepDive: As duas metades sempre começam com the. Cada metade tem um comparativo: adjetivos curtos ganham -er (lower, bigger), adjetivos longos usam more/less (the more expensive). Com quantidade use the more/the less (incontáveis) e the more/the fewer (contáveis). Muitas vezes o verbo 'is' some: The bigger the order, the bigger the discount (= the bigger the order is…). Cuidado com irregulares: good → better, much/many → more, little → less.
examples: The sooner we order, the lower the price.
Quanto mais cedo pedimos, mais baixo o preço.
The larger the batch, the bigger the discount.
Quanto maior o lote, maior o desconto.
The longer the delay, the higher the cost.
Quanto maior o atraso, maior o custo.
The more we order, the more we save.
Quanto mais pedimos, mais economizamos.
The clearer the contract, the fewer the problems.
Quanto mais claro o contrato, menos problemas.
The better we negotiate, the lower the price.
Quanto melhor negociamos, mais baixo o preço.
The higher the volume, the cheaper the unit.
Quanto maior o volume, mais barata a unidade.
The less stock we keep, the higher the risk.
Quanto menos estoque mantemos, maior o risco.
mistakes: Sooner we order, lower the price.
The sooner we order, the lower the price.
Cada metade precisa começar com 'the'.
The more early we order, the better.
The earlier we order, the better.
Use o comparativo earlier, não 'more early'.
The bigger order, the bigger discount.
The bigger the order, the bigger the discount.
Não esqueça o 'the' antes de cada substantivo.
The most we order, the most we save.
The more we order, the more we save.
Use o comparativo more, não o superlativo most.
The longer the delay, the more high the cost.
The longer the delay, the higher the cost.
High é curto: use higher, não 'more high'.
quick: The sooner we order, the ___ the price. (low)
The larger the batch, the ___ the discount. (big)
The longer the delay, the ___ the cost. (high)
The more we order, the ___ we save. (much)
The clearer the contract, the ___ problems. (few)

celebrate.en: Impressive. Linking cause and effect like this makes your negotiations in English sharp and persuasive.
celebrate.pt: Impressionante. Ligar causa e efeito desse jeito deixa suas negociações em inglês afiadas e persuasivas.

title: Reporting what the supplier agreed to
grammar: Verbos de relato + infinitivo (agree to / offer to / refuse to / promise to / remind to)
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a relatar compromissos de fornecedores com verbos de relato + infinitivo: agree to, offer to, refuse to, promise to e remind (someone) to. Em Compras, isso é essencial para reportar o resultado de uma negociação na Delta Ducon.
intro: After a call with a supplier you have to report the result: they agreed to ship on Monday, offered to cover the freight, but refused to lower the price.
Today we learn reporting verbs with the infinitive: agree to, offer to, refuse to, promise to and remind (someone) to. They help you report negotiations clearly at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Fabio from Procurement. The supplier agreed to deliver on Monday and offered to pay the freight. They refused to change the price, but promised to send the invoice today. I reminded them to confirm the lead time. Let us practise reporting a negotiation.
vocab: The supplier made a clear commitment to deliver.
They agreed to meet the deadline.
He promised to send the invoice today.
The supplier offered to cover the freight.
I asked for a confirmation in writing.
practice: The supplier made a clear ______ to deliver on Monday.
He promised to send the ______ today.
The supplier offered to cover the ______.
I asked for a ______ in writing.
Please remind them to send the ______.
We will not ship without a firm ______.

audio.title: Reporting the negotiation
audio.text: After the meeting, I reported the results to my manager. The supplier agreed to deliver the filter bags on Monday. They offered to cover the freight for the late shipment. However, they refused to lower the unit price. They promised to send the invoice by the end of the day. I reminded them to confirm the lead time in writing. Overall, it was a good negotiation.

readAloud: The supplier agreed to deliver on Monday.
They offered to cover the freight.
They refused to lower the price.
He promised to send the invoice today.
I reminded them to confirm the date.
fill: I reminded them ___ the lead time. (confirm)
qa: What did the supplier agree to do?
They agreed to deliver on Monday.
Did they help with the freight?
Yes, they offered to cover the freight.
Did they lower the price?
No, they refused to lower the price.
When will they send the invoice?
They promised to send it today.
What did you ask them to do?
I reminded them to confirm the lead time.
sentences: The supplier agreed to deliver the parts on Monday.
They offered to cover the freight for the late shipment.
They refused to lower the unit price.
He promised to send the invoice by the end of the day.
I reminded them to confirm the lead time in writing.
The supplier agreed to meet the deadline.
They refused to accept our first counteroffer.
She promised to call us before Friday.
grammarPoint: Vários verbos de relato são seguidos de to + infinitivo: agree to, offer to, refuse to, promise to. The supplier agreed to deliver on Monday. — O fornecedor concordou em entregar na segunda. Remind precisa de um objeto (a pessoa) antes do to: I reminded them to confirm. — Eu os lembrei de confirmar.
deepDive: Todos esses verbos pedem to + infinitivo, nunca o gerúndio: agree to send (não 'agree sending'). A negativa fica no infinitivo com not: They promised not to raise the price. Atenção ao remind: ele exige um objeto — remind SOMEONE to do (I reminded HIM to sign). Não confunda agree to do (concordar em fazer) com agree with someone (concordar com alguém, opinião). Offer to do = oferecer-se para fazer.
examples: The supplier agreed to deliver on Monday.
O fornecedor concordou em entregar na segunda.
They offered to cover the freight.
Eles se ofereceram para cobrir o frete.
They refused to lower the price.
Eles se recusaram a baixar o preço.
He promised to send the invoice today.
Ele prometeu enviar a fatura hoje.
I reminded them to confirm the date.
Eu os lembrei de confirmar a data.
We agreed to meet the deadline.
Concordamos em cumprir o prazo.
She promised not to raise the price.
Ela prometeu não aumentar o preço.
The manager asked me to follow up.
O gerente me pediu para dar sequência.
mistakes: The supplier agreed delivering on Monday.
The supplier agreed to deliver on Monday.
Agree pede to + infinitivo, não o gerúndio.
They refused lowering the price.
They refused to lower the price.
Refuse pede to + infinitivo.
I reminded to confirm the date.
I reminded them to confirm the date.
Remind precisa de um objeto (them) antes do to.
He promised send the invoice.
He promised to send the invoice.
Não esqueça o 'to': promised to send.
They offered covering the freight.
They offered to cover the freight.
Offer pede to + infinitivo, não o gerúndio.
